purpose: Research the weakest project-native finite causal/relational primitive that can make arbitrary finite pre-sampling operationally falsifiable, or prove that current Foundation semantics cannot decide online generation without an additional physical/causal axiom.

forbidden_reownership: Bell/CHSH or measurement-independence prior art as project novelty

evidence_inputs.boundary: finite deterministic/rational/adaptive response tables remain finitely pre-samplable when arbitrary counterfactual tables are allowed
full-support m-step r-ary deterministic pre-sampling requires at least r^m distinct seed states
setting-local plus measurement-independent completions obey CHSH; one exact rational target violates it; relaxing measurement independence has target-specific cost M_min=2/15
partial-action definedness belongs to declared future behavior but does not decide latent-versus-generated ontology

research_constraints: Do not adopt Bell locality or measurement independence as Foundation axioms by fiat.
Keep observable no-signalling distinct from Bell-local latent factorization.
Preserve A4 ownership of multivalued correspondence/support.
Prefer exact finite/integer/rational definitions and counterexamples.
Executable checks support falsification but do not replace proof.
Any physical conclusion remains subject to P016 falsification/promotion discipline.

resolution_bar.positive: Give a minimal typed causal/intervention primitive and prove an operational obstruction to all latent completions in a declared class, with weakest hypotheses, prior-art boundary, reduction to current Foundation when the extra primitive is absent, and at least one exact finite executable witness.
resolution_bar.negative: Prove an impossibility theorem showing that current Foundation plus a stated weaker candidate class cannot distinguish online generation from finite latent completion, and identify the narrowest additional physical/causal axiom needed to make the distinction testable.

first_action: Define the weakest candidate notion of causal accessibility/intervention context that is strictly weaker than importing Bell locality plus measurement independence, then test whether arbitrary finite response-table completion still factors through it. If it does, turn that failure into the next impossibility lemma rather than adding a stronger axiom ad hoc.
